articulation.label: music
articulation.alt: music: /m/ → /j/ → /u/ → /z/ → /ɪ/ → /k/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /m/: Close both lips; air goes through the nose.
/j/: Front tongue high; glide into the next vowel.
/u/: High back tongue; round the lips.
/z/: A narrow gap near the ridge; add voice.
/ɪ/: Front tongue, a little lower and relaxed.
/k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
